applies_why: This judge text does the thing the rule governs by using a verse's not stating a detail as the ground for an UNDERDETERMINED finding.
quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: does not state a link or its contrary: either this bars using any verse's silence about a needed detail as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED, or it bars only total silence about the whole link while allowing silence about a sub-detail; the judge's finding uses the latter reading.
why: The judge treats the verse's silence about whose body is the channel as a reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which K-S2 forbids.
